faqs.answer: The official 2026 landing page states 10+2 with 50% in Physics, Chemistry and Biology/Mathematics/Agriculture, or a two-year agriculture diploma with 50%.

faqs.question: What fee is documented for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at GLA?
faqs.answer: ₹83,000 / year · 2026-2027. Published later-year academic fees are ₹85,000, ₹87,000 and ₹89,000. Examination, alumni, refundable caution and accommodation charges are separate; obtain the complete payable statement. Included charges: First-year academic fee for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture, Mathura campus.

faqs.question: How does admission to GLA work?
faqs.answer: GLA’s agriculture landing page sets out eligibility followed by GLAET. Applicants should also read the full university admission instructions for their category. Check the stated qualifications: Match your subjects or agriculture diploma with the programme entry requirements. Follow the GLAET instructions: The programme page identifies GLAET; confirm the applying-year test and counselling details.

faqs.question: What is the recorded ICAR scope for GLA?
faqs.answer: GLA University, Mathura, (Private): • B.Sc (Hons.) Agriculture (Intake- 60), recorded term 2025-02-27 to 2030-02-26. This entry applies to the named unit and programme.

faqs.question: What practical learning is described at GLA?
faqs.answer: The degree page describes harvesting vegetables, herbs and flowers for experiential study. The faculty page identifies field experiments and internships.

faqs.question: Which teaching facilities are documented at GLA?
faqs.answer: Agriculture teaching land: The programme page identifies farming land for hands-on work. Agricultural workshops and laboratories: The landing page identifies these as practical teaching resources.

faqs.question: What student facilities are documented for GLA?
faqs.answer: GLA’s agriculture pages identify practical crop work and subject laboratories within the faculty’s teaching approach. Accommodation availability, meal charges and transport arrangements for your entry year still need direct confirmation.

faqs.question: What scholarship information is available for GLA?
faqs.answer: GLA maintains a scholarship page with both programme-specific and government-linked support. A dated B.Sc. Agriculture merit award was not verified; terms for B.Tech or pharmacy should not be transferred to this course.

faqs.question: What training and outcome evidence is available for GLA?
faqs.answer: The agriculture admission page displays some university-wide career counters, including an explicitly overall highest package. They are not presented here as agriculture outcomes. A dated B.Sc. Agriculture placement report remains unverified.

faqs.question: How can I contact GLA about an application?
faqs.answer: Published phone: +91 9027068068. Published email: glauniversity@gla.ac.in. Official admissions: https://www.gla.ac.in/info/bsc-agri/

faqs.question: Which dated admission notices are recorded for GLA?
faqs.answer: No dated admission event is verified in this profile. The official channel is https://www.gla.ac.in/info/bsc-agri/; check the notice for the programme and entry year you intend to join.
